
{{alias}}( dtype, defaultValue, isValidScalar )
    Returns a function for creating zero-dimensional ndarrays.

    Parameters
    ----------
    dtype: string|DataType
        Data type.

    defaultValue: any
        Default scalar value.

    isValidScalar: Function
        Function for checking whether a value is a valid scalar value.

    Returns
    -------
    ctor: Function
        Function for creating zero-dimensional ndarrays.

    Examples
    --------
    > var f = {{alias}}( 'float64', 0.0, {{alias:@stdlib/assert/is-number}}.isPrimitive )
    <Function>
    > var arr = f()
    <ndarray>[ 0.0 ]

    --------
